_comment: Every number here is an ASSUMPTION you can overwrite. Costs come from thatway_execution_plan.html (its own caveat: estimates, not checked against current prices). Prices, installs, conversion and retention are NOT from data: replace them with TestFlight and App Store numbers as soon as they exist. After editing run: python3 scripts/vault/model_finance.py --write Each scenario has a target_net_12m (net revenue in the first 12 paid months); the script scales installs to hit it, so the table shows the installs that target demands.

costs.name: AWS, after credits and free tier

Conservative.note: Below the plan's own range: a quiet launch, little word of mouth. Target: A$1.5k net in the first 12 paid months.

Plan low.note: The bottom of the plan's stated range: A$5k net in the first 12 paid months.

Plan high.note: The top of the plan's stated range: A$25k net in the first 12 paid months.
